# The Genesis Hub

> The Genesis Hub is a coworking space, private office facility and corporate event venue in Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria. It is powered by The Genesis Company, an innovation ecosystem builder for tech talents, founders and SMEs.

## Address
Beside NIPCO Gas Station, A&T Hotel Close, off Oloko Junction, Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria. Near FUTA.

## Services
- Hot desks and daily coworking: high-speed Wi-Fi, uninterrupted power, ergonomic seating
- Dedicated and private offices: secure executive suites for startups and enterprise teams
- Corporate event space: conference hall for tech meetups, hackathons and corporate workshops
- Startup Launchpad: incubation and acceleration programmes powered by The Genesis Company

## Facilities
24/7 power, high-speed internet, on-site security.

## The Genesis Company
Acceleration, talent matching and enterprise strategy.

## Links
- Website: https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/

## Rates (NGN)
Coworking: daily 2,000; weekly 12,000; monthly 40,000.
Event hall, corporate (trainings, workshops, seminars, board meetings): 50 heads 20,000 per hour or 160,000 per day (9am-5pm); 100 heads 22,000 per hour or 200,000 per day.
Event hall, social (parties, cocktails, networking, hangouts, freshers/FYB parties): 50 heads 27,000 per hour or 220,000 per day; 100 heads 30,000 per hour or 240,000 per day.
Above 100 guests: Special Plans, custom quote.
All event packages include: PA system with 2 microphones, digital display screen, 8KVA power supply (8 hours), 2 restrooms, parking.
Add-on: advanced sound setup (mixer amp plus lapel/headset microphones) 40,000.
Security deposit 50,000, refundable within 48 hours after inspection. Overtime charged at the standard hourly rate. Generator fuel and standard cleaning included.
